description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the historical versions of a dataset in a specified agent workspace and returns the version names, descriptions, and creation time. Deleted versions are not included in the list. Do not specify nextToken in the first request. For subsequent requests, use the nextToken value from the previous response for paging to retrieve the next page
description_zh: 分页查询指定智能体空间中某个数据集的历史版本，返回版本名称、描述和创建时间。已删除的版本不在列表中返回。首次请求不传 nextToken，后续请求使用上一次响应中的 nextToken 获取下一页
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop list-dataset-versions --agent-space my_agent_space --dataset-name product_faq_dataset --api-version 2026-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatasetVersions

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent workspace to which the dataset belongs. Specify the name of an existing agent workspace that you have permissions to access
parameters.help_zh: 数据集所属的智能体空间（AgentSpace）名称。请填写已存在且有权访问的智能体空间名称
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. You can call the ListDatasets operation to obtain the name. The name must be 4 to 63 characters in length. It must start with a lowercase letter and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). It cannot end with an underscore or contain consecutive underscores
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称。可调用 ListDatasets 获取。名称长度为 4～63 个字符，以小写字母开头，仅包含小写字母、数字和下划线，不能以下划线结尾或包含连续下划线
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of versions to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100. The actual number of returned versions may be less than this value
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的版本数量。取值范围为 1～100，默认值为 100。实际返回数量可能小于该值
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. Do not specify this parameter in the first request. To query subsequent pages, pass the nextToken value from the previous response as is, and keep the agent workspace and dataset name unchanged. The example is for demonstration purposes only. Use the actual token returned by the API operation
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询令牌。首次请求不传；查询后续页时，原样传入上一次响应中的 nextToken，并保持智能体空间和数据集名称不变。示例仅用于展示，请使用接口实际返回的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en: The response information returned when the request succeeds
schema.description_zh: 请求成功时返回的响应信息

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of versions per page used for this query, which is not the actual number of versions returned on the current page
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询使用的每页最大版本数量，不是当前页实际返回的版本数量

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This parameter is returned when a next page exists. To query the next page, pass this value as is to nextToken. If this parameter is not returned or is empty, no next page exists. The example is for demonstration purposes only
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页查询令牌。存在下一页时返回，查询下一页时将该值原样传入 nextToken。不返回或为空表示没有下一页。示例仅用于展示

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

total.description_en: The total number of versions of the dataset, excluding deleted versions. This value is not limited by the current page size
total.description_zh: 数据集的版本总数，不包括已删除的版本，不受当前页大小限制

versions.description_en: The list of historical versions of the dataset on the current page. An empty array is returned if no versions meet the conditions
versions.description_zh: 当前页的数据集历史版本列表。没有符合条件的版本时返回空数组

items.description_en: The information about a single historical version of the dataset
items.description_zh: 单个数据集历史版本的信息

createTime.description_en: The creation time of the version, in RFC 3339 format, including time zone information. For example, the Z in 2026-11-11T06:00:00Z indicates UTC
createTime.description_zh: 版本创建时间，使用 RFC 3339 格式，包含时区信息。例如 2026-11-11T06:00:00Z 中的 Z 表示 UTC

description.description_en: The description provided when the version was created. If no description was provided, an empty string is returned
description.description_zh: 创建版本时填写的描述信息。未填写时为空字符串
description.example: 首次评估使用的数据集版本

version.description_en: The name of the historical version, which corresponds to the name specified when the version was created. This value can be used as the version parameter for DeleteDatasetVersion
version.description_zh: 历史版本名称，与创建版本时指定的名称对应，可作为 DeleteDatasetVersion 的 version 参数
